raw:
The documents show Oscar Piastri racing alongside Lando Norris at McLaren in 2025 (Documents 2, 4, 6, 7, 8). No other teammate of Piastri appears in them. None of the documents report championship results, though, so they cannot confirm whether Norris won a drivers' championship. Based on my general knowledge rather than the documents, Norris won the 2025 World Drivers' Championship, which would make him the answer.

ANSWER: Lando Norris
